g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure hub-and-spoke landing zone with Azure Firewall

g.title: None.None.Node.27
g.text: Customers reach the web app's public IP
Application Gateway terminates TLS and filters the request
It routes the request to the scale set across two zones
The web servers query Azure SQL through its private endpoint
Office users connect from the head office network
A site-to-site VPN carries the traffic to the hub's VPN gateway
Azure Firewall inspects it against the central policy
Allowed traffic crosses the VNet peering to the HR app in the internal spoke
which reads PostgreSQL through its private endpoint
